DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with Atypia.

The imaging confirmed a thickened endometrial stripe, which in a 65-year-old with postmenopausal bleeding is highly suspicious for endometrial cancer until proven otherwise, even though the latest unverified report was normal. We will proceed with the hysteroscopy to obtain a biopsy for definitive histological diagnosis.
